item.title: Sergei Prokofiev: Peter and the Wolf - With Jean Reno and Renaud Capuçon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:
Prokofiev wrote Peter and the Wolf in 1936 as a symphonic tale for children, but all ages can enjoy this unique work where the narrated Russian folk story is illustrated marvellously by the orchestra, with each character performed by its own instrument.Renaud Capuçon conducts the Orchestre de Chambre de Lausanne and cult actor Jean Reno narrates.
From 05.03.2025 05:00

item.title: Martha Argerich Plays Prokofiev (11.06.2021)
item.description:
Star Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Prokofiev’s third piano concerto with the  French Radio Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of conductor Myung-Whun Chung. Also on the programme is Prokofiev’s Ballet Suites from Rome and Juliet.
From 11.06.2021 17:00

item.title: Barbara Hannigan Conducts Stravinsky and Weill - Orchestre Philharmonique de Radio France (02.06.2021)
item.description:
Canadian soprano and conductor Barbara Hannigan conducts and sings with the French Radio Orchestra in a sensual programme celebrating the city of lights: gay Paris.Mezzo-soprano Julia Dawson, tenor Ziad Nehme and bass-baritone Douglas Williams also perform.ProgrammeIgor Stravinski – Pulcinella Kurt Weill – Youkali Jacques Offenbach - La Gaîté parisienne
From 02.06.2021 19:01

item.title: Mozart at the Hotel Sully (Paris) (05.02.2021)
item.description:
On a summer’s eve renowned pianist and conductor Lars Vogt leads the orchestre de chambre de Paris in a performance of Mozart’s much-loved Piano Concerto No. 9.
From 05.02.2021 00:00

item.title: Georges Bizet: Carmen - Opéra-Comique, Paris (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.03.2025)
item.description:
Performed by mezzo-soprano Gaëlle Arquez, Bizet’s famous opera transcends the ages in the gilded splendour of the Salle Favart. This daring production is directed by Andreas Homoki and conducted by Louis Langrée.
From 03.03.2025 05:00

item.title: Vincenzo Bellini: Norma - Theater an der Wien, Vienna (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.02.2025)
item.description:
The stage director Vasily Barkhatov is famous for his razor-sharp character analyses translated into powerful visuals. In his reading, Norma rides an emotional rollercoaster that takes her from love to fury and despair. Making her debut in the title role is one of the greatest singers of our time: Asmik Grigorian.
From 27.02.2025 04:00

item.title: Alexander Rodin: Kateryna - A premiere by Odessa Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.01.2025)
item.description:
To mark the anniversary of the war, ARTE Concert is screening Kateryna, a Ukrainian opera by Alexander Rodin, commissioned by Odessa Opera. Kateryna premiered at the Odessa opera house in September 2022, despite the Russian war of aggression. The premiere had originally been planned to coincide with World Theater Day on 27 March 2022.
From 08.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Albéric Magnard: Guercœur - Opéra national du Rhin, Strasbourg (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2024)
item.description:
Guercœur, the knight and a freedom fighter, meets with an early death and ends up in heaven. But his soul is unable to rest and begs to be returned to earth. At the Opéra national du Rhin, Stéphane Degout plays the title role under the direction of Ingo Metzmacher, while Christof Loy’s staging explores the boundaries between the two worlds.
From 02.12.2024 18:00

item.title: Richard Strauss: Salome - Staatsoper Hamburg (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.01.2025)
item.description:
Dmitri Tcherniakov’s remarkable new staging of Richard Strauss’s Salome tells a very dark tale. Asmik Grigorian shines in the title role of Salome, whose craving for autonomy and revenge takes a fateful turn. Streamed live on ARTE Concert, this performance of the opera from the Staatsoper Hamburg under the baton Kent Nagano promises to be thrilling theatre.
From 05.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Francesco Cilea: Adriana Lecouvreur - Latvian National Opera, Riga (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.06.2024)
item.description:
“Adriana Lecouvreur”, Calabrian composer Francesco Cilea’s most famous work, is a lyrical retelling of the story of Adrienne Lecouvreur, the famous Parisian actress who died in suspicious circumstances in 1730.
From 15.06.2024 05:00

item.title: Monteverdi: L’incoronazione di Poppea - Gran Teatre del Liceu, Barcelona (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.11.2024)
item.description:
Love, power and ambition collide on the stage of Barcelona’s Teatre de Liceu in Monteverdi’s L’incoronazione di Poppea, directed by Calixto Bieito.
From 13.11.2024 09:52

item.title: Bedřich Smetana: The Bartered Bride - Czech National Theatre, Prague (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.04.2024)
item.description:
Young Mařenka is madly in love with Jeník, but her father has a better catch in mind for her... From Prague’s National Theatre, Czech film and stage director Alice Nellis revisits Bedřich Smetana’s iconic opera.
From 02.04.2024 05:01

item.title: Gioachino Rossini: William Tell - Opéra de Lausanne (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.11.2024)
item.description:
Gessler’s hat became a metaphor for enforced submissive behaviour. When William Tell refuses to salute the tyrannical Governor’s hat, his punishment is to put his son’s life in danger. Rossini’s opera, based on Friedrich Schiller’s play, is performed in Lausanne for the first time. With Jean-Sébastien Bou in the title role and Luigi De Donato in that of the Governor.
From 27.11.2024 05:00

item.title: Rossini: Il Barbiere di Siviglia - From the Vienna State Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.11.2021)
item.description:
Rossini’s Il Barbiere di Siviglia ranks among the most popular and most successful works in the entire operatic canon. For his new staging of the work at the Vienna State Opera the director, actor and media artist Herbert Fritsch has assembled a star-studded cast that includes Juan Diego Flórez in the role of Count Almaviva, Ildar Abdrazakov as Don Basilio, Vasilisa Berzhanskaya as Rosina and Étie.....
From 27.11.2021 05:00

item.title: Mikael Karlsson: Melancholia - Royal Swedish Opera, Stockholm (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.01.2025)
item.description:
On the day of her wedding, Justine suddenly sees a red star in the sky: the planet Melancholia is coming dangerously close to Earth. In an attempt to calm her down, her husband Michael lavishes all his love on her, while her cold and callous mother, Gaby, only adds to her distress. Her sister Claire tries to comfort her with her kindness, but no one can contain the mysterious forces ignited within.....
From 21.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Leevi Madetoja: The Ostrobothnians - Finnish National Opera Helsinki (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.01.2025)
item.description:
Finland may be the happiest country on earth, but it is also known as the land of a thousand sad songs. Lurking in the shadows of this Nordic welfare state are violence, alcoholism and inequality. A century after its premiere, the most Finnish of all operas is now being performed in a new production at the Helsinki Opera House.
From 13.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Marc-Antoine Charpentier: Médée - Paris National Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.05.2024)
item.description:
Lea Desandre, William Christie and Les Arts Florissants introduce Marc-Antoine Charpentier’s Médée to the repertoire of the Opéra national de Paris, directed by David McVicar.
From 30.05.2024 05:00

item.title: Sergei Prokofiev: War and Peace - Bavarian State Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.10.2023)
item.description:
Director Dmitri Tcherniakov and conductor Vladimir Jurowski deliver a breathtaking version of Sergei Prokofiev's monumental opera at the Munich Opera House. 
From 08.10.2023 05:00

item.title: Richard Strauss: Salome - Directed by Christof Loy in Helsinki (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.03.2024)
item.description:
The literary source for Richard Strauss’s opera immortalizing the degeneracy of Herodes Antipas, King of Judea, and his step-daughter Salome, was supplied by Oscar Wilde. It tells of Herodes, who is keeping the prophet Jochanaan captive inside a cistern. Salome tries to seduce him and on being rebuffed, forces her stepfather to serve her the prophet’s head on a silver platter.
From 03.03.2024 05:00

item.title: Sergei Prokofiev: The Fiery Angel - Teatro Real, Madrid (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2025)
item.description:
Live from the Teatro Real in Madrid, an adaptation of Prokofiev’s flamboyant masterpiece by the ever-radical Calixto Bieito
From 02.02.2025 05:00

item.title: "Dalibor" by Bedřich Smetana - At the Czech National Theatre (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2021)
item.description:
As part of the ARTE Opera Season, the Czech National Theatre is showing a classic from the Czech repertoire: In this opera, Bedřich Smetana tells the story of an avenger figure from Czech history, whom he elevates to the rank of national hero. The opera is conducted by Jaroslav Kyzlink while Jiří Nekvasil signs the stage direction.
From 23.11.2021 05:01

item.title: Georg Friedrich Handel: Giulio Cesare - At the Dutch National Opera (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.03.2024)
item.description:
In Amsterdam, conductor Emmanuelle Haïm and director Calixto Bieito take on Handel’s famous Giulio Cesare.
From 13.03.2024 15:33

item.title: Rameau: Hippolyte et Aricie - At the Opéra Comique in Paris (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.02.2022)
item.description:
In October 1733, the audience at the Académie Royale de Musique witnessed the birth of a revolutionary work: Hippolyte et Aricie. With its inventiveness and musical richness, Rameau’s opera marks a break in the history of French music. A similarly revolutionary duo – Jeanne Candel and Raphaël Pichon – get to grips with this work for the Opéra Comique.
From 01.02.2022 14:06

item.title: Circus of Tomorrow (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.12.2024)
item.description:
Filmed from the beguiling Musée des Arts Forains in Paris, this exceptional show brings together former winners of the Festival Mondial du Cirque de demain for a special spectacle.
From 19.12.2024 05:00

item.title: A Citizen of the People (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.11.2024)
item.description:
The Democratic Alliance has won elections in a German free state with a huge majority. But is its charismatic leader, Dominik Arndt, a threat to democracy? Maximilian Steinbeis's play depicts the meteoric rise of a populist minister-president whose dark persuasive power and cunning upsets the established order. Performed in the Federal Press Conference in Berlin and produced by award-winning the.....
From 18.11.2024 16:15

item.title: The Snow Queen - After Hans Christian Andersen (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.11.2024)
item.description:
In 1844, Hans Christian Andersen imagined the story of an evil troll who wanted to drive the goodness out of the hearts of humans. To achieve this, he hangs a huge magic mirror in front of the moon. When it breaks, the people touched by its shards become insensitive to human kindness and see the worst in people.
From 15.11.2024 05:00

item.title: Baro d'evel: Qui som? - Avignon Festival 2024 (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.12.2024)
item.description:
At the crossroads of circus, theatre and dance, this is the latest creation from the enchanting Franco-Catalan company Baro d'evel, who have been invited to the Avignon festival, for the first time. A total art form woven from fine threads of fantasy, poetry and burlesque.
From 10.12.2024 16:40

item.title: Ground Control - The Stranglers, The Jesus and Mary Chain, Keren Ann & Quatuor Debussy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.01.2025)
item.description:
In a disused Paris railway depot Christophe Cassel hosts two legendary British bands that are still going strong: The Stranglers and The Jesus and Mary Chain. They are joined by Keren Ann accompanied by her string quartet and the Australian whistler, Molly Lewis.
From 18.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Sparks At the Château d'Hérouville (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.07.2024)
item.description:
Sparks, the legendary Californian band with 25 albums, invites you to the Château d'Hérouville, France's famous studio in the countryside where many of rock and pop greats have recorded over the years.. The duo tell their story and play their greatest hits live such as  "This Town Ain't Big Enough for Both of Us" to "My Baby's Taking Me Home" and "So May We Start".
From 03.07.2024 05:00

item.title: Sounds Like Art - Gossip - Neue Nationalgalerie Berlin (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.06.2024)
item.description:
ARTE welcomes international artists to some of the best art collections in Europe. American group Gossip, led by the charismatic singer Beth Ditto, engages in a dialogue with works by Lucy Raven and Yoko Ono at Berlin’s Neue Nationalgalerie.
From 25.06.2024 18:55

item.title: Berlin Live: Boy George & Culture Club (16.12.2021)
item.description:
For many, Culture Club epitomised 1980s pop music with global hits such as ‘Do You Really Want to Hurt Me?’ and ‘Karma Chameleon’. They take to the Berlin Live stage as part of an international tour promoting their new album ‘Life’.
From 16.12.2021 05:00

item.title: Morcheeba - Berlin Live (18.11.2021)
item.description:
London group Morcheeba have been going strong for 25 years with their unique chilled sound, most famously on their much celebrated 1998 album Big Calm. In 2018 they took to the Berlin stage to perform from their ninth album Blaze Away
From 18.11.2021 11:05

item.title: Gretel Hänlyn - Echoes with Jehnny Beth (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.10.2024)
item.description:
British singer Gretel Hänlyn takes the stage for the first time in Paris for Echoes with Jehnny Beth.
From 08.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Sébastien Tellier - ARTE Concert Festival (19.01.2021)
item.description:
Sébastien Tellier is a singular artist with multiple facets: Darling of the Paris electro scene since the turn of the century and yet able to represent France at the kitsch fest of the Eurovison song contest in 2008. Performing at the ARTE Concert Festival on November 13 2020 at the release of his latest album ‘Simple Minds’.
From 19.01.2021 14:40

item.title: Cigarettes After Sex in Private Paris Concert (23.11.2020)
item.description:
In a special private concert in Paris, Greg Gonzales and his band perform from their newly released second album, ‘Cry’.
From 23.11.2020 18:15

item.title: Bastille - Sounds Like Art - Turner Contemporary Museum in Margate (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.03.2025)
item.description:
Sounds Like Art invites musicians to play in the midst of works of art in a European museum. In this edition, British pop group Bastille present their new album & at the Turner Contemporary Museum in Margate on the English coast. Lead singer Dan Smith says he is particularly interested in the art of Anya Gallaccio and Antony Gormley.
From 11.03.2025 05:00

item.title: In Conversation with Mia Hansen-Løve (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
Mia Hansen-Løve describes her love for the cathartic and emancipatory dimension of cinema. From her early films, the intimate and the personal unfold with sincerity and a minimalistic aesthetic. "Bergman Island" is in competition this year at Cannes.
From 27.12.2023 14:08

item.title: In Conversation with François Ozon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.12.2024)
item.description:
François Ozon navigates diverse genres, from tragedies to popular comedies and enigmatic tales. With curiosity and a playful approach, he deciphers the unknowns of life through his films, crafting stories that reveal his unique cinematic voice.
From 09.12.2024 10:43

item.title: In Conversation with Louis Garrel (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2024)
item.description:
Louis Garrel, actor and filmmaker, discusses "The Innocent", where he merges his love for introspective drama and playful humor. From starring in his father Philippe Garrel’s art films to embodying the King of France in "The Three Musketeers", Garrel has navigated diverse genres. In this interview, he reveals how "The Innocent" became the ultimate synthesis of his cinematic dreams.
From 02.12.2024 09:55

item.title: A Conversation with Walter Salles (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.01.2025)
item.description:
Walter Salles, a former documentary filmmaker, is deeply inspired by Brazil’s history. His films vividly depict the country’s social and political realities, intertwining past and present. Central to his storytelling are the perspectives of people in a society shaped by the absence of fathers, both figuratively and literally – offering a poignant view of Brazilian identity.
From 29.01.2025 11:00

item.title: In Conversation with Justine Triet (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
The 2023 Palme d'Or winner "Anatomy of a Fall" directed by Justine Triet is now showing in theatres. We revisit the filmmaker's distinctive and lively style. Triet is known for her remarkable feminist portraits. Her films "Age of Panic", "Victoria" and "Sibyl" form a turbulent body of work depicting contemporaryand urban France.
From 27.12.2023 14:06

item.title: Conversation with Robert Guédiguian (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.03.2024)
item.description:
Before becoming a filmmaker, Robert Guédiguian always thought he would be an activist who lived intensely. His cinema is like him: From Marseille, expansive and joyful, poetic and above all, human.
From 15.03.2024 18:30

item.title: In Conversation with Michael Haneke (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2024)
item.description:
Michael Haneke retraces his career and talks about the first films he made for television, but also how they differ from his later films intended for a cinema audience.
From 02.12.2024 09:58

item.title: A Conversation with Rebecca Zlotowski (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.12.2024)
item.description:
For Rebecca Zlotowski, being a filmmaker today is all about taking an intimate look at the world. As a screenwriter and director, she makes films by infusing her personal obsessions with major social movements. Zlotowski’s work is imbued with poetry, charm and a paradoxical mystery between a pragmatic and mysterious view of life.
From 06.12.2024 12:00

item.title: A Common Thread (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:
17-year-old Claire hides her pregnancy and takes a job with Madame Mélikian, a grieving haute couture embroiderer. As they stitch side by side, their shared sorrow and unspoken struggles weave an unbreakable bond. Through delicate threads and silent understanding, they find comfort, resilience and an unlikely sense of family in each other.
From 05.03.2025 09:38

item.title: A Police Romance (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:
In a small French suburban police station, Lieutenant Emilie Carange is drawn to Jamil Messaouden, a young trainee. As they investigate drug activity reported by an elderly Algerian woman, their attraction intensifies, complicating the case. Passion and duty collide in this gritty thriller where love and law enforcement spiral dangerously out of control.
From 05.03.2025 09:41

item.title: A Talking Picture (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
Rosa Maria, a history professor, and her young daughter embark on a cruise from Lisbon to Bombay, exploring iconic historical sites across the Mediterranean. Along the way, they meet intriguing passengers, sparking rich conversations on culture and civilisation. But as the serene journey unfolds, an unforeseen event disrupts the harmony, leaving a lasting impression on all aboard.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: The Stonebreaker (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
After Angela dies while working in the fields, Giuseppe and his son Antò lose everything. Now homeless among other seasonal workers, Giuseppe clings to the promise he made to Antò that his mother will return. As they struggle to survive, Antò sees his father as a hero, while Giuseppe faces a painful reality he refuses to accept.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: Nelly (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
When the doctor of a small town dies suddenly, his wife Nelly is left to navigate her grief while caring for their three children and facing family pressures. As mourners gather, Nelly refuses to let a funeral parlour take his body, disrupting tradition. Over the course of four intense days, she struggles with love, loss and the complexities of saying goodbye.
From 01.03.2025 05:00

item.title: I'm Going Home (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
After losing his wife, daughter, and son-in-law in a tragic accident – an elderly actor must rebuild his life while caring for his orphaned grandson. As he returns to the stage and takes on a new role in a film directed by an American, he grapples with grief and the quiet routines that now define his days. A poignant reflection on love, loss and how to manage the end of a career.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: The Dark Room (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
Aliénor, a bold young woman in 14th century France, wins the right to marry her childhood love Bertrand. But he abandons her immediately after the wedding, fleeing to Italy. Refusing to accept his rejection, she follows him to Siena, disguising herself as another woman to win his heart. Inspired by Boccaccio’s “The Decameron”, the film is a luminous tale of deception and determination.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: The Letter (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
A young, spiritual woman marries a devoted doctor but feels no love for him. She then falls for Pedro Abrunhosa, a poet and singer, yet keeps her distance, confiding only in a cloistered nun. As jealousy consumes her husband, she cares for him as his health declines. While his death offers her freedom, her choices and confessions are central to the ruminations at the core of this adaptation of a c.....
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: Pieces of Me (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
17-year-old Erell copes with her stagnant small-town life by filming everything – her moody father, sick mother and rebellious friends. When her sister Sarah suddenly returns after having vanished years ago, Erell’s world is turned upside down. As she pieces together the past, she confronts hard truths about her family and herself.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: Party (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2025)
item.description:
In the idyllic Azores, a wealthy couple hosts a garden party and invite two old friends – sparking a web of seduction, intrigue and unspoken desires. Amid elegant conversations and subtle power plays, the beauty of the setting contrasts with the emotional undercurrents between the four. Five years later, they meet again and resume their conversations, giving free rein to their repressed desires.
From 01.03.2025 00:00

item.title: Bellissima (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.01.2025)
item.description:
Maddalena, a working-class mother, drags her daughter to an audition at the Cinecittà Studios hoping for stardom. As her obsession escalates, Luchino Visconti reveals the harsh realities of post-war Italy, with Anna Magnani’s powerful performance at its core.
From 06.01.2025 11:10

item.title: Chronicle of Poor Lovers (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.01.2025)
item.description:
In 1925 Florence, Mario, a young typographer, moves to Via del Corno for love but finds himself entangled in the lives of his anti-fascist neighbours. As tensions rise, personal passions clash with political turmoil, and the small street becomes a microcosm of Italy’s descent into dictatorship.
From 01.01.2025 00:00

item.title: Golden Eighties (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2024)
item.description:
Set in a vibrant shopping mall, "Golden Eighties" combines Chantal Akerman's feminist insight with musical comedy. Shop keepers and clients navigate infatuations, including three women who vie for one man's heart in song and dance. As consumerism frames their romance, the film explores deeper themes of identity and survival in modern society, punctuated by dazzling musical performances.
From 25.11.2024 17:55

item.title: The Camp Followers (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.01.2025)
item.description:
In 1942, a young Italian officer must transport Greek women – forced into sex work to survive – to military brothels in Albania. As they cross war-torn landscapes, Valerio Zurlini explores fascism's cruelty and the plight of women, with an international cast including Marie Laforêt and Anna Karina in this feminist film.
From 01.01.2025 00:00

item.title: Je Tu Il Elle (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2024)
item.description:
In Chantal Akerman’s sexually daring first feature, a nameless young woman breaks from her self-imposed solitude to embark on a road trip, finding ephemeral romantic encounters along the way. Interacting with a script, a truck driver, and a former lover – her journey explores the fluidity of identity and the different forms relationships can take.
From 25.11.2024 17:56

item.title: The Captive (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2024)
item.description:
Simon’s love for Ariane transforms into a suffocating obsession. His desire to possess her escalates as he shadows her daily activities, from museum visits to opera outings, fuelled by suspicions of her attraction to women. Based on Marcel Proust’s “La Prisonnière”, the film delves into Simon's psychological entrapment, highlighting his compulsive control over Ariane's elusive affections.
From 25.11.2024 17:55

item.title: The Meetings of Anna (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2024)
item.description:
In this character study, Chantal Akerman portraits filmmaker Anna as she tours through Europe to promote her newest movie. With every fleeting but poignant encounter she makes along the way, her emotional aloofness becomes more apparent. From intimate strangers in Germany to family in Belgium, every interaction unveils how isolated Anna truly is.
From 25.11.2024 17:57

item.title: Almayer's Folly (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2024)
item.description:
In 1950s Malaysia, a European merchant becomes obsessed with finding treasure to secure his daughter’s future. His dreams crumble under the dual pressures of his own greed that turns into torment, and the oppressive English domination the country is experiencing – leading the remote village he lives in to fall into ruin.
From 25.11.2024 17:58

item.title: Two Cents Worth of Hope (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.01.2025)
item.description:
In a post-war Neapolitan village, Carmela and Antonio’s love is tested by economic hardships and strict dowry expectations. Renato Castellani’s final installment of his trilogy paints a lively yet tender portrait of Italy’s working class. This optimistic neo-realist tale captures the resilience of romance and the enduring hope of humble folk in the face of adversity.
From 01.01.2025 00:00

item.title: Just Walk Naked! - By Emmanuel Mouret (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.06.2024)
item.description:
Stéphanie and Clément's relationship could be just fine if Clément would just agree to walk around naked when they’re on their own... Emmanuel Mouret's remarkable first film.
From 14.06.2024 18:30

item.title: Manoel de Oliveira, the Architect Filmmaker (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.02.2025)
item.description:
When Portuguese filmmaker Manoel de Oliveira died in 2015 at the age of 106, he left behind him a body of work unique in cinema:  Oliveira transforms the everyday into the sublime and deals with themes such as death, love, the rituals of life and the passing of time with elegance and subtlety.
From 26.02.2025 12:10

item.title: Chantal Akerman: Always On The Road (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.11.2024)
item.description:
Throughout her career, Belgian filmmaker Chantal Akerman (1950-2015) produced some of the most singular and committed films of her generation. This documentary looks at some of these films, including 'Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles', which was named 'greatest film of all time' by the British Film Institute in 2022.
From 28.11.2024 13:54

item.title: Sharon Stone - Survival Instinct (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.01.2025)
item.description:
With Paul Verhoeven's "Basic Instinct" (1992) and Martin Scorsese's "Casino" (1995), Sharon Stone became a sex symbol and one of the most famous actresses in 90s Hollywood. But behind her elegant 1940s film star good-looks lies a complex character that had to work hard to survive in a male dominated industry.
From 12.01.2025 05:00

item.title: Table Manners - By Ursula Meier (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.06.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Georgia's Queer Scene (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.09.2024)
item.description:
Georgia hosts the only Pride march in the Caucasus region. In this country, where homosexuality was a crime until 2000, the pro-Russian government equates LGBT struggles with Western propaganda. Against a backdrop of high tension and open discrimination, the Queer artistic community In Tbilisi is resisting.

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Food (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
Why can food make us so happy? Could a nutrient for happiness exist? Ronja von Rönne meets two people for whom the art of cooking and the love of food are the key to happiness: French artist Johanna Dumet paints modern still lifes and Nada Abouelsaad organises big cooking evenings.
From 12.12.2023 13:50

item.title: Tracks - Blasphemy: The Way to Faith? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.03.2024)
item.description:
Some people who hold religious beliefs feel excluded from organised religion and are finding new ways of reaching God, ways that traditional churches may find blasphemous. Tracks meets artists who are reinventing Christian iconography and creating inclusive queer religious spaces.
From 14.03.2024 15:19

item.title: Unhappy - The Promise of Beauty (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
Can beauty make us happier? If people beautiful people have more career opportunities, are they happier as a result? And what is the real power of beauty? A philosophical exploration hosted by Ronja von Rönne.

item.title: Unhappy - The Time of Your Life (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.10.2023)
item.description:
How can we live a happy life? And should we be pleased that our lives are short? Ronja von Rönne investigates the philosophy of happiness by meeting Jean-Remy von Matt, a major figure in German advertising and Sister Katharine, who left her job in finance to become a nun.

item.title: Tracks - The Voice of AI (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.12.2023)
item.description:
Artificial intelligence can now clone artists' voices. And nothing can compete with your favourite singer... quite like your favourite singer. Tracks meets out-of-the-box thinkers trying to tame the technology before it swallows them whole.
From 27.12.2023 17:48

item.title: Draw for Change - Mexico: Illustrator Mar Maremoto (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.03.2024)
item.description:
Mar Maremoto is a queer artist with a punk aesthetic and boundless energy. Her work is vivid and emotionally charged, her drawings and murals striking. She explores the multiple repercussions of machismo in her native Mexico, the anguish of fat-shaming and the difficulty of not conforming to societal norms.
From 06.03.2024 00:00

item.title: TRACKS - Digital Horror - What Scares Gen Z? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.08.2024)
item.description:
Who would have thought that one day an ordinary open space could give us the creeps? For the generation that has grown up with the Internet: the web has redefined the codes and forms of horror, giving us a clearer picture of the anxieties of our time. From backrooms and analogue horror to digital urbex, these creepy anomalies are transforming our relationship with reality and renewing our attracti.....

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Creativity (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.12.2023)
item.description:

item.title: The Book of My LIfe - With Francesca Melandri (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.02.2025)
item.description:
"Great literature is about creating this miracle of empathy between the writer and the reader. And this miracle of empathy is the greatest political value of literature". Francesca Melandri is one of the best-known voices in contemporary Italian literature. With Jagoda Marinic, she talks about her free-spirited childhood and her life before she began writing books.
From 03.02.2025 17:25

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Friendship (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.12.2023)
item.description:
What characterises friendships? And how can these relationships be nurtured? Focus on our chosen families with Ronja von Rönne, who talks to a range of personalities about their friendships.

item.title: Tracks - Art Inspired by Our Absurd Labour Market (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.06.2024)
item.description:
The world of work is out of balance. Essential jobs are undervalued while "bullshit jobs" like happiness managers or managers of managers thrive. In this absurd reality, do artists have the power to challenge the status quo? Tracks went to visit two satirical art projects to dig deeper into the true worth of work.

item.title: Tracks - Skate Culture in Morocco (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.09.2024)
item.description:
Tracks meets the leading lights of the skate scene in Morocco.In 2020, Nassim Lachhab became the first professional skateboarder in Morocco, and on the entire African continent. Despite a booming skate culture, the country attracts few sponsors, and it is extremely difficult for Moroccan skateboarders to take part in international competitions.

item.title: Tracks - Afro Rock: The True Origins of Rock? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.06.2024)
item.description:
Little Richard claimed that if he'd been white, Elvis wouldn't have existed. Today, a new generation of artists is reviving rock with Afro sounds and reigniting the debate about the genre's origins. These bands blend rock riffs with Afrobeat, mix metal with reggae and restore rock to its original, diverse roots – showcasing the vibrant fusion of styles that makes Afro rock what it is.

item.title: Tracks - How to Party in Iran (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.08.2024)
item.description:

Yet in secret, behind closed doors in Tehran or outside the borders of the Islamic Republic, it is still possible to party properly. Tracks meets those artists who are keeping the Iranian party spirit alive, whatever it takes.

item.title: Utopia - Streetphilosophy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.07.2020)
item.description:
Do human beings have the vision to create utopia? And if so, should we start out small or think really big? From digital algorithms to old-fashioned local politics, Streetphilosophy asks: how do we create a better world?

item.title: Unhappy - Does Money Make Us Happy? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Amapiano: The Sound of South Africa (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.04.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Can Post-porn Awaken Our True Desires? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.01.2025)
item.description:
Entire generations have learned about sex through mainstream porn, blurring the lines between personal desires and platform-driven fantasies. But if our sexuality is shaped by algorithms, can’t we take back some control? The post-porn movement is doing exactly that. Aimed at creating pornography that reflects honest, consensual sex – its creators are making waves online.
From 02.01.2025 12:20

item.title: Streetphilosophy - Don't Lose Hope! (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.08.2022)
item.description:
In this episode, Ronja explores what can give us hope for the future even when things seem bleak. At Leopoldplatz, she meets one of the most hopeful people in Berlin: DJ Bombay sells curries from his food truck and is always in a good mood. "I've been through so many crises in my life that nothing can knock me out," he says. Then there's  boxer Mazen, who loses every fight and still goes on. Nun S.....

item.title: Face What’s Foreign to You! - Streetphilosophy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.11.2020)
item.description:

item.title: Be Wild! - Streetphilosophy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.05.2021)
item.description:
Leave behind society, go out into nature and find again your true wild self? In our controlled societies, the idea is tempting. Ronja von Rönne goes to meet a biker gang, for whom being wild is a way of life.

item.title: Find Your Faith! - Streetphilosophy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.07.2020)
item.description:

item.description:
Deborah Feldman found worldwide fame with her autobiography Unorthodox, adapted into a highly successful Netflix series. In this extensive interview, she talks about the central and vital role books have played in her life, on post-war writing dealing with the holocaust, and also contemporary events, notably the Israel-Hamas war.

item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Punk, Glitter, Glamour: The New Underground Cabaret (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.08.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Draw for Change - India: Cartoonist Rachita Taneja (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.03.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Deep Thought - In Conversation with Philipp Blom (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.08.2023)
item.description:

And he immediately asks, "Then who are we?" In conversation with Yves Kugelmann, Philipp Blom engages in a deep, thought-provoking exploration.

item.title: Streetphilosophy - Be a Man! - But How? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2022)
item.description:

item.description:
Some may think that religion and punk rock don’t mix, but artists from a Muslim background are embracing hardcore rock to show their faith and culture in a new light.

item.title: Unhappy - Happiness and Habitat (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2023)
item.description:
Far from being a mere material detail, our homes can have a real influence on our well-being... City or country? Flat or house? A philosophical exploration of how we live, hosted by Ronja von Rönne.
From 23.11.2023 11:54

item.title: Unhappy - Of Men and Horses (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
Can regular contact with animals make us happier? Ronja von Rönne meets two people who are passionate about animals.

item.description:

item.title: Use Technology! - Streetphilosophy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.12.2020)
item.description:
Does technological progress help or hinder us as individuals? Jonas finds out by meeting a cycling enthusiast and a jujitsu champion.

item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Café-Bar Culture in France (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.09.2024)
item.description:
Tracks ventures into typical French café-bars. Unfashionable and sometimes overlooked, they are nevertheless at the heart of community and artistic life.

item.title: Unhappy - Running and Hiking (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
Ronja von Rönne interviews two people whose lives have been transformed by walking or running. What effects do these activities have on our mental health?

item.description:
Ex-footballer turned anti-poverty activist Neven Subotić had the world at his feet. But it wasn't enough. He knew something was missing and turned to books to help him find meaning in his life. What he read changed his outlook, his way of thinking, and his future.

item.title: Tracks - New Erotic Fanzines: More than Playboy? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.03.2025)
item.description:
A new wave of erotic magazines is breaking the traditional heterosexist mould and encouraging a new engagement with desire, body image and sexuality. Tracks met Barcelona duo Paco & Manolo who produce the bi-yearly magazine Kink dedicated to art and eroticism and American Brynne de Turk Weaver who edits the semi-erotic Pour Toi publication.
From 10.03.2025 17:00

item.title: Tracks: Record Box - Ángeles Toledano (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:

item.description:
Video gaming is hugely popular all over the world. But what would games be without their soundtrack? Music is not only an integral part of games, but also an increasingly important part of pop culture. Tracks delves into the world of video game music appreciation and finds out how composers create the right sound world to capture gamers’ imaginations.
From 05.03.2025 18:00

item.title: Tracks - Roma Rappers against the Patriarchy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - The Art of Protest (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.03.2025)
item.description:

item.title: Julio Iglesias - Latin Crooner, Global Star (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.02.2025)
item.description:

item.title: Britney No Filter - Be Sexy and Shut-up (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.01.2025)
item.description:

Britney became both the emblem and the scapegoat of this ambivalent culture. Is she a virgin? Has she had a boob job? But the real question lies elsewhere: what is expected of a famous woman?

item.title: Britney No Filter - I Post Therefore I Am (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.01.2025)
item.description:
On 23 June 2021, Britney Spears appeared in court in Los Angeles to ask for her guardianship to be lifted. It was through her voice, rather than her image, that she regained her humanity and freedom. On her Instagram account, she regains control of her image and shows off every aspect of herself. But what does she have to say about our own relationship with social networks?

item.title: Stand Up - A Passion for Laught - Women Aren't Funny (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.12.2024)
item.description:
This documentary looks at the history of stand up and why the punchline professionals are so popular. But things are changing: More women are taking to the stage and their humour is tackling age-old taboos.
From 03.12.2024 16:47

item.title: Tracks East - Protests, Parties, Death (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.03.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Tracks - Will AI Replace Photography? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.08.2024)
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: How Streaming Consumed Music (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.09.2023)
item.description:
Having every piece of music imaginable in your pocket is normal today, but it took several a lot of upheaval in the music industry to get us there. Music-lover and journalist Sophian Fanen tells us how we went from CDs to streaming, from scarcity to infinite access. He traces the history of our listening habits in the 21st century through the mp3, illegal downloads, the iPod, to streaming services.....

item.title: Tracks - Berlin's Floating Alternative Scene (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.12.2023)
item.description:
In Berlin, clubs and alternative spaces are closing and rents are soaring. But in one of the capital's richest districts, there is resistance. On the shores of Rummelsburg lake, behind Ostkreuz station, alternative groups have built makeshift barges in defiance of the Berlin property market.

item.title: Amanda Lear: Call Me Mademoiselle (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.12.2024)
item.description:

She lived with Salvador Dalí and went out with Brian Jones of the Rolling Stones.A born performer, with legendary mystique and charm, she kept her true self hidden behind numerous faces. From Bowie to Berlusconi, from London to Paris: the story of Amanda.....

item.title: NFT: Chaos in the Art Market - Money is King (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.01.2024)
item.description:
The NFT frenzy, triggered by the record sale of Beeple's digital work, led to a boom in speculation on the market. A year later, from spring 2022, the bankruptcy of several cryptocurrency companies caused the price of non-fungible tokens to fall considerably.

item.title: Tracks East - Fear and Repression in Belarus (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.02.2024)
item.description:
Since the anti-government protests in Belarus in 2020, the international media has disappeared. But the population still lives in fear with the secret service hunting down dissidents by analysing video footage of the protest using AI. Tracks East meets with Belarusians to find out what life is like in the country.
From 06.02.2024 14:30

item.title: Virile (3/3) - Male-Party (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.02.2025)
item.description:

item.title: The Taylor Swift Effect (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.01.2025)
item.description:
Taylor Swift has become the most famous woman in the world and the current most streamed recording artist. From her childhood in suburban Pennsylvania to Nashville, where she started her career as a country artist, to her current international fame as a preeminent pop star, Taylor Swift has galvanised an immensely loyal following with her subtly emotional songs and canny marketing and self-promoti.....

item.description:
More than twenty years after the end of the fighting between Kosovo and Serbia,  history continues to cast its dark shadow. The recent upsurge in tensions between the two countries is making matters worse. Tracks East met the artists who want to build bridges between communities.

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (1/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.12.2023)
item.description:
In Beijing SUNK’s techno production is influenced by her interest in traditional Chinese culture. IN Taipei, Elvis T discovers a scene rising from the ashes.

item.description:

item.description:

item.description:
Many people using Google maps to navigate urban spaces. But what if we could reinvent maps to show us more than just the fastest route from A to B? Counter-cartography seeks to challenge our utilitarian relationship with space on its head.

item.title: Tracks East - Sport in Crisis Times (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:
Sport has always been political and is often a vehicle for propaganda. Can sport still be apolitical in 2024, or has it lost its neutrality for good? Find out in episode of Tracks East.

item.description:

item.title: NFT Chaos in the Art Market - Disillusion (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:

item.title: Stand Up - A Passion for Laughter - Without Borders (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.12.2024)
item.description:
This documentary looks at the history of stand up and why the punchline professionals are so popular. Episode 1: Stand up comedy has crossed national borders and language barriers. From New York to Kyiv, every city has its own scene.

item.title: The Planet of the Apes - A Milestone of Science Fiction (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.07.2024)
item.description:

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (3/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.12.2023)
item.description:

In Beijing, SUNK visits DADA Bar and Aurora, two clubs that show how resilient the scene is, while tamiX discovers the comics of Mongolian artist Lu Ming.

item.title: Tracks - Zoo-futurism (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.02.2025)
item.description:
Be they mermaids or octopuses, artists are pushing the boundaries of species and challenging the place of human beings at the top. Zoo futurists look beyond the mere human to imagine a world where we reconnect with the natural world and with other animals in it.

item.title: Virile (2/3) - Toxic (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.02.2025)
item.description:
Could the so-called crisis of masculinity be an attempt to reinforce the gender hierarchy, with women subordinated to men? Are masculinists threatened by female emancipation?
From 14.02.2025 05:00

item.title: Tracks - In M.I.A.'s Footsteps: Tamil Culture Conquers the World (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.02.2025)
item.description:
"Paper Planes", "Bucky Done Gun"... In the 2000s, the singer M.I.A. was at the top of the charts. In her lyrics she regularly denounced the civil war in Sri Lanka and the persecution suffered by her people: the Tamils. Originally from India and Sri Lanka, the Tamil population numbers 85 million people around the world. Tracks meets young Tamil artists in Europe who are walking in M.I.A’s footsteps.....

item.title: Tracks Inside - Techno & TikTok (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:

item.description:
In 2017, computer scientists Matt and John create CryptoPunks, NFTs that can be collected and exchanged for free via blockchain. At the same time, the artist Robness discovers blockchain, a new world that he sees as an artistic utopia. None of the three men realise that they are at the centre of a revolution.
From 11.06.2024 05:00

item.title: Tracks - Influencers in MMA (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.12.2023)
item.description:
Influencers and musicians in Germany are stepping into the Mixed Martial Arts ring to fight in front of sell-out crowds. What does this mean for professionals in the sport?
From 14.12.2023 16:16

item.title: Black Surfers Matter - The Bay Boys Gang (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.07.2024)
item.description:
South of Los Angeles, the Bay Boys gang have terrorised and harassed outsiders. If you don't own a villa on the beach at Palos Verdes, or know someone who does, it's hard to catch a wave. But a handful of stubborn surfers have decided to resist this unfair localism.
From 05.07.2024 05:00

item.title: Tracks: Songwriting Special - Pop Music: The Great Recycling Business (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.04.2022)
item.description:
Have you ever wondered why pop songs sometimes sound a little too familiar? Welcome to the world of pop-recycling where borrowing, sampling and interpolation are the order of the day. Featuring interviews with Placebo, Ed Sheeran, Charlie XCX and Lauv.
From 11.04.2022 15:20

item.title: Klapping / Emilie Brout & Maxime Marion / Sisto / Ami Yerewolo - Tracks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.12.2021)
item.description:
The art of klapping, where dance meets football.  Also in the programme: Artist couple Emilie Brout and Maxime Marion harvest the internet. Spanish multi-media artist Pascual Sisto talks about his new film ‘John and the Hole’ and Ami Yerewolo raps in Bambara to traditional African music.
From 07.12.2021 15:10

item.title: NFT: What the Punk! - Hurricane (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.08.2024)
item.description:
A phenomenon in the art market, CryptoPunks now bring together a close-knit, passionate community, but are also becoming a target for profiteers. Robness views the arrival of Wall Street speculators and financiers with disgust and uses his art to combat those who want to pervert his space of freedom.
From 29.08.2024 08:00

item.title: Tracks East - Travelling in Dangerous Times (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.03.2024)
item.description:
From wealthy Russians flying to Dubai for a shopping spree, to Ukrainians taking a break in Transcarpathia, in the west of the country, to Albania now facing mass tourism. Tracks East focuses on holidays in times of crisis.
From 07.03.2024 12:22

item.title: Tracks - The Power of Afrobeat (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.01.2024)
item.description:
Afrobeat or afrobeats, a more general overarching term, is taking the world by storm. Nigerian artists are at the forefront of a genre that is gaining recognition in Europe. Tracks goes to Berlin to meet singer Rose May Alaba at the Afrobeats Festival.
From 09.01.2024 14:28

item.title: Tracks East - Ukraine: 2 Years On (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.02.2024)
item.description:
For almost two years, Tracks East has been accompanying artists in Ukraine and abroad whose lives have been brutally turned upside down by the war in Ukraine. This special issue draws on stories since the start of the war and gives a voice to young figures of pop culture.
From 26.02.2024 12:35

item.title: Virile (1/3) - The Origins of Masculinity (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.02.2025)
item.description:
What if it was exhausting to live up to the ideals of masculinity? From Antiquity to the present day, this is the story of virility.
From 14.02.2025 05:00

item.title: Just Dance - Final Year at the Paris Conservatoire (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.12.2023)
item.description:
They are 18 years old and starting their final year of dance training at the prestigious Paris Conservatoire. They not only have to pass their exams, but also land a contract with a company. With auditions coming thick and fast, the pressure is on, and there's no room for error in the ultra-selective world of dance.
From 29.12.2023 14:30

item.title: Britney No Filter - You're Not Born a Fan, You Become One (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.01.2025)
item.description:
Under her father's tutelage, Britney was stripped of all control over her life. In the face of her enforced silence, her fans took over and brought her into virtual existence, appropriating her image. How has social media allowed fans to reverse the balance of power between the media and the public?
From 16.01.2025 16:43

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (4/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.01.2024)
item.description:
After a trip to Fruityspace, Beijing's most famous indie record shop, SUNK plays her first gig. Meanwhile, tamiX prepares to go abroad for the first time since the pandemic.
From 15.01.2024 15:28

item.title: Black Surfers Matter - The N Word (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.07.2024)
item.description:
Surfing reflects wider racial problems that persist in the United States: many black surfers prefer to surf at night to avoid being harassed as segregation still casts a shadow over the beaches of California.
From 05.07.2024 05:00

item.title: Tracks - Racism in Sport (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.07.2024)
item.description:
With the rise of the far right in Europe, German athletes and artists from a migrant background are increasingly exposed to racist hostility. Ahead of the Paris Olympics, TRACKS asks: How do minority athletes cope with giving their all for a country that shows them so much hatred?
From 03.07.2024 11:02

item.title: Black Surfers Matter - Surfing and Swastikas (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.07.2024)
item.description:
California, the epitome of cool and alternative culture? But not everything was laid-back vibes. Swastikas were already adorning surfboards in the 1930s.
From 05.07.2024 05:00

item.title: Tracks - Russian Artists Against the War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.04.2022)
item.description:
Russian artists have two choices: silence, or exile. There's been a mass creative exodus in recent weeks, including Russian rap stars like Face and Oxxxymiron. Art rockers IC3PEAK post protest videos that would get them arrested in Russia. TikTok star Nikita Sass bravely continues to post his opinion and stays. Few dare to do that.
From 04.04.2022 10:03

item.title: Tracks - Morocco: Surfers and Artists against Insta-Gentrification (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.08.2024)
item.description:
Imsouane, a small fishing village in south-west Morocco, is an increasingly popular destination for tourists. Some of the longest waves in Africa can be found here in a paradise for the international surfing crows. But the town is being transformed by the Moroccan authorities to welcome more tourists, with local residents paying the price by being forced from their homes. Tracks takes a look at th.....
From 21.08.2024 15:59

item.title: Total Immersion Special - Tracks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.01.2022)
item.description:
A total immersion into the world of sound: Sound engineer Nicolas Becker explains his craft featured in films such as Sound of Metal and La Haine. FUJIIIIIIITA, makes his own instruments to let his audience have new sound experiences. With more than 500 films (and 500,000 photographs), Boris Lehman is the first-person filmmaker par excellence.
From 06.01.2022 16:41

item.title: Tracks East - Enemies Forever? Voices against Hate in the Middle East (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2024)
item.description:
Since the Hamas attack and Israel's response, the conflict in the Middle East has escalated with much loss of life. Yet some voices are calling for reconciliation.
From 02.02.2024 18:09

item.title: In-Game Photography - Art of Gaming (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2022)
item.description:
Video game photographer Martin Geisler shows us with examples from “Skyrim”, “the Hunter” and “Squad” that photography within gameplay has become as art form.
From 02.02.2022 08:01

item.title: Tracks East - Scarred: Ukrainians Defy the Trauma of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.02.2024)
item.description:
After almost two years of war, Ukraine is a traumatised nation. A large proportion of the population is suffering from physical or psychological injuries, and often both. Tracks East looks at how the country is coping with mass trauma.
From 07.02.2024 16:54

item.title: Tracks - London's New Goth Scene (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.02.2025)
item.description:
Goth is back from the grave and now it is queerer, more diverse, and partying harder. Tracks goes to the British capital to meet the new London scene and finds out what makes today’s goths tick.
From 12.02.2025 12:38

item.title: Stand Up - A Passion for Laughter - Minority Battles (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.12.2024)
item.description:
This documentary looks at the history of stand up and why the punchline professionals are so popular. Episode 3: Stand up has become a way for minorities to fight back against dominant discourses. But when comiedians get political, do they lose their sense of humour?
From 03.12.2024 15:58

item.title: GEO Reportage - Insects - the Food of the Future (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.02.2025)
item.description:
Pasta made from worm flour, grass-hopper salads or muesli bars with crickets… Insect food products could be appearing on our plates soon if Laetitia Giroud and Julien Foucher get their way. We visited the couple at their insect farm in Spain.
From 22.02.2025 05:00

item.title: The Inca Grass Bridge of Q'eswachaka (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.02.2025)
item.description:
In Peru, every year, the people who live in remote mountain villages gather to build the Inca bridge of Q'eswachaka, a traditional structure of woven grass, and the last of its kind. This ancestral know-how inherited from the Incas, and the enduring spirit of community, enables the villagers to pull off a stunning feat of engineering, time and again.
From 16.02.2025 05:00

item.title: A Year in Kihnu - Estonia - Between Lightness and Melancholy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.02.2025)
item.description:
For centuries women have been in charge on the isolated Estonian island of Kihnu. Whilst the men were away at sea, the women would look after the animals, harvest the crops and look after the children. Today, there are less opportunities on the island so many young people want to leave. Filmmaker Julia Finkernagel immersed herself in the local community over twelve months.
From 23.02.2025 05:00

item.title: The Halligen Islands Under Water (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.02.2025)
item.description:
The Wadden Sea National Park, which stretches from the Netherlands to Denmark, is punctuated by a string of islands endowed with a unique geological feature: due to their very low elevation, they are are regularly flooded at high tide. This unique characteristic results in a rare biosphere,where mudflats, sandbanks, meadows and salt marshes succeed one another.
From 28.02.2025 08:01

item.title: Wild Europe - France: The Brenne Nature Park (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2024)
item.description:
A region of a thousand ponds in central-western France, the Brenne Regional Natural Park is a biodiverse environment that attracts naturalists and photographers alike. A continental wetland covering 1,800 square kilometres, this "wild Brenne" doesn't quite live up to its nickname...
From 11.09.2024 05:00

item.title: New Zealand – Animals at the End of the World - 360° Geo (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.02.2025)
item.description:
New Zealand’s exceptional biodiversity means that a large number of species are found on these islands in the South Pacific and nowhere else. Some of these species are threatened with extinction such as the Southern royal albatross or the Yellow-eyed penguin.
From 17.02.2025 05:00

item.title: Heligoland: A Red Cliff Wilderness (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.01.2025)
item.description:
50 kilometres from the continent, the tiny island of Heligoland is a German outpost in the North Sea. It is home to numerous bird species and serves as a breeding spot for seals. Scientists and conservationists are looking for ways to preserve the local biodiversity, while continuing to keep the island open for tourism.
From 16.01.2025 05:00

item.title: And Man Created the Secretary (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.03.2025)
item.description:
Being a secretary was originally a male domain. But this all changed at the beginning of the 20th century as the profession became overwhelmingly female. Why this happened is a fascinating story, one that this documentary shares with ten women secretaries. They respond to the history of their profession and tell of their own experiences in the workplace.
From 04.03.2025 05:00

item.title: Capitalism in America - The Cult of Wealth (2/3) - Making the rich pay (1921-1946) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.02.2025)
item.description:
A history of American capitalism. Episode 2: Appointed Secretary of the Treasury in 1921, aluminium magnate Andrew Mellon developed the 'trickle-down' theory. But the millionaires' paradise collided with the economic crash of 1929, which plunged the USA into the Great Depression and mass unemployment. Could Roosevelt save America from dire economic straits?
From 25.02.2025 18:40

item.title: Capitalism in America - The Cult of Wealth (3/3) - Who Wants to be a Billionaire? (1981 - Today) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.02.2025)
item.description:
In the 1980s, Ronald Reagan and the republicans pushed through policies of deregulation and tax cuts whilst Silicon Valley became the new Eldorado for young companies such as Apple and Microsoft. As the internet grew, capital flowed into big tech making huge fortunes and monopolies. The poor and middle classes paid their taxes and the rich paid less.
From 25.02.2025 18:45

item.title: Capitalism in America - The Cult of Wealth (1/3) - A Paradise for Millionaires (1870-1920) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.02.2025)
item.description:
120 years ago, a capitalist Eldorado emerged in the USA, paving the way for today’s billionaires such as Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Bill Gates. How did the power of the super-rich consolidate, especially during the depression after 1929 or during Ronald Reagan's policy of deregulation and tax cuts in the 1980s?
From 25.02.2025 18:40

item.title: Tzedek: The Righteous Ones (2/2) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.10.2024)
item.description:
Marek Halter continues his search for the Righteous ones in this second part of his extraordinary documentary. He speaks to people in Italy, Denmark and elsewhere who helped save 500,000 Jews from the holocaust.
From 21.10.2024 15:39

item.title: Mafia and Banks (2/3) - Follow the Money (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:
This three-part documentary tells the little-known story of the alliances between criminal organisations and financial institutions from the 1920s to the present day. Episode 2: the 1980s banking deregulation coincided with the rise of the heroin and cocaine trade in the USA. The result was a bonanza for drug traffickers and banks.
From 25.01.2024 16:30

item.title: Crazy Borders - Enclave Chaos in Cooch Bechar (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2024)
item.description:
An enclave of one country in an enclave of another country, itself within an enclave… This oddity was located on the border between India and Bangladesh in the mad patchwork of enclaves in Cooch Behar. This is a case for Crazy Borders!
From 25.09.2024 15:20

item.title: Crazy Borders - Birobidzhan: A Jewish State in the USSR (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2024)
item.description:
Why does a Russian region in the far east have Yiddish as an official language? The region of Birobidzhan was the Soviet Union’s plan for a Jewish homeland within the socialist world.
From 25.09.2024 15:16

item.title: This Little Land of Mines (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.02.2025)
item.description:
During the Vietnam War, the United States bombed Laos on a massive scale and in secret. The largest bombing campaign in history means that an estimated eighty million pieces of unexploded ordnance still litter the country decades later. Laotians risk their lives every day in the painstaking work to clear the country of UXO, a process which could take 2,500 years.
From 11.02.2025 18:10

item.title: Sports Stories - Football and the Industrial Revolution (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.06.2024)
item.description:
England in 1883, the working-class team from Blackburn Olympic beat the elite Old Etonians in a surprise win. What was the significance of this event in British social history and in the history of sport?
From 11.06.2024 14:03

item.title: Crazy Borders - France's Holy Lands (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.09.2024)
item.description:
Why did French President Jacques Chirac chase Israeli police from a church in Jerusalem? Strangely for a secular nation, France owns property in the Holy Lands which the country ealously guards.
From 26.09.2024 11:34

item.title: Chinese Concentration Camps (2/2) - Total Surveillance (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.03.2023)
item.description:
An investigation into the terrifying Chinese concentration camp system. This second episode reveals the state of total surveillance that is the reality for Chinese people in the 21st century.
From 23.03.2023 12:19

item.title: The Battle of Chile (3/3) - People Power (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.09.2023)
item.description:
In the months leading up to the military coup in Chile, supporters of the socialist president Allende try to create a " state within a state " with political and charitable actions - as a counterweight to the anti-reform forces in the country, supported by the Nixon administration in the USA.
From 12.09.2023 12:30

item.title: 14 Diaries of the Great War - The Homeland (6/8) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2024)
item.description:
The soldiers' prospect of returning home is an important motive to continue fighting. In the first total war in history, a new phrase is coined: The Home Front. "Fighting" takes place not only in the trenches, but also in the factories, in fields and in schools. The burden of war is borne by soldiers as well as women, workers, children and the elderly.
From 17.10.2024 05:00

item.title: China’s Concentration Camps (1/2) - Laogai: The Chinese Gulag (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.03.2023)
item.description:
Established by Mao Zedong in the 1940s, China’s concentration camp system has committed 50 million people, intellectuals, workers, students, peasants, to a life of hell over the last eighty years, with 20 million deaths. Not dissimilar to the Soviet Gulag, this cruel system of oppression was intended to bring about a ‘thought reform’ in the prisoners.Survivors of the Laogai system, now living in .....
From 22.03.2023 10:40

item.title: Crazy Borders - Neutral Moresnet (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.09.2024)
item.description:
A territory whose inhabitants were stateless? That's what happenede in the territory of Moresnet, co-managed by Germany and Belgium. A tax haven with a major zinc mine, which was also a den of smugglers…
From 24.09.2024 11:33

item.title: Anas Modamani, and a Fateful Selfie - Domino Effect (1/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
One small action can lead to big consequences. This is the story of how Anas Modamani, a Syrian refugee, had his life turned upside after he took a picture with Chancellor Angela Merkel. He went on to take Facebook to court and Germany fined the tech over a million euros.
From 24.08.2021 20:19

item.title: The Battle of Chile (1/3) - The Insurrection of the Bourgeoisie (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2023)
item.description:
Chilean president Salvador Allende wanted to modernise his country and fight poverty. But conservative groups organised a series of wildcat strikes and the White House put pressure on Chile's economy. When they realised that they could not eliminate the president by legal means, they prepared a coup d'état. This bold three-part work of cinema vérité captures the many voices of Chilean society in.....
From 11.09.2023 18:00

item.title: The Last Summer of the GDR - Freedom and Anarchy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.11.2024)
item.description:
After the fall of the Berlin Wall, citizens of East Germany had to get used to a new way of consuming, working, and living. New-found freedoms were a breath of fresh air for many but in the chaos leading up to reunification with West Germany, the experience was also disconcerting.
From 26.11.2024 16:24

item.title: The First Year - A film by Patricio Guzmán (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.01.2024)
item.description:
A focus on the first year of the Popular Unity government in Chile, where Salvador Allende was elected as President in September 1970.
From 10.01.2024 17:57

item.title: Crazy Borders - Steinstücken: A West Berlin Exclave in East Germany (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2024)
item.description:
The village and West Berlin exclave of Steinstücken was less than a kilometre from West Berlin, surrounding by the GDR. During the height of the Cold War, they had real problems…
From 25.09.2024 09:54

item.title: 14: Diaries of the Great War - Destruction (5/8) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2024)
item.description:
1916 becomes the year of horrific battles. A new kind of death machine is set in motion with submarines, aeroplanes, tanks and poison gas. On the Somme, the Western powers aim to achieve a breakthrough against the German troops, while Russia tries to put Austria-Hungary under pressure on the Eastern front. The number of victims exceeds all predictions.
From 17.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Crazy Borders - The Vennbahn: German or Belgian? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.09.2024)
item.description:
A thin strip of Belgian territory in the German countryside which marks out five German enclaves? How did the Vennbahn, actually a cycle lane, come into being?
From 26.09.2024 11:52

item.title: 14: Diaries of the Great War - The Abyss (1/8) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2024)
item.description:
We follow 14-year-old Marina Yurlova who joins her father, Cossack Colonel Yurlov, on a train to the front. Artist Käthe Kollwitz and her husband must accept their 17-year-old son’s decision to enlist. The Austrian Karl Kasser is sent to the front despite an injury and ten-year-old Yves Congar from Sedan expects France to win quickly. He feels safe in his family until German troops arrive on the d.....
From 17.10.2024 05:00

item.title: 14: Diaries of the Great War - Desire (4/8) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2024)
item.description:
Millions of mothers and wives must endure years of separation from their sons or husbands. They are tormented by the uncertainty of whether their loved ones are still alive. The men in the trenches are told to concentrate on killing and not worry about their wives back home. The war destroys the lives and health of countless soldiers.
From 17.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Ahed Tamimi, the Kid Activist - Domino Effect (4/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Ahed Tamimi grew up in a small village in occupied Palestine, and protest was in her blood. She had grown up yelling at Israeli soldiers and demonstrating for a free Palestine. So the day that soliders showed up on her family’s property, she didn’t hesitate : she marched up to them and slapped them. Her anger would land her in prison and make her an icon of the resistance.
From 24.08.2021 20:22

item.title: Marie Laguerre, Street Harassment Hero - Domino Effect (2/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Maire Laguerre was walking home from work when she was sexually harassed by a man in the street. When she told her aggressor to get lost, he threw an ashtray at her and punched her in the face. She decided to post the video of her attack online and it went viral, eventually triggering a change in street harassment laws in France.
From 24.08.2021 20:19

item.title: At War for Algeria - The Return of Charles de Gaulle (4/6) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.10.2024)
item.description:
Charles de Gaulle, the incarnation of the French Resistance during World War II, returns to power to form an emergency cabinet (the last of the Fourth Republic) and resolve the Algerian crisis. For the supporters of French Algeria, he is a saviour. The French army manages to beat back the insurgents with a new strategy. Calm seems to return in 1959, but how long will it last?
From 23.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Crazy Borders - Rockall: A North Atlantic Dispute (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.09.2024)
item.description:
Why are two Royal Marines standing guard on this tiny rock covered in bird droppings? Around Rockall, the continental shelf is disputed by British, Irish, Danish and Icelandic governments. Unless Greenpeace get in on the act... This is a clear case for Crazy Borders!
From 24.09.2024 11:18

item.title: At War for Algeria - Independence (6/6) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.10.2024)
item.description:
With the yes vote triumphant, the way looks set for Algerian independence. Anti-independence ultras form a civilian militia, the OAS, which carries out numerous attacks in Algeria and mainland France as the conflict continues to the bitter end.
From 23.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Crazy Borders - Llivia, Between France and Spain (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.07.2022)
item.description:
Did you know that the last war between France and Spain took place in the 1970s? It was the war of the stop signs in Llívia, a Spanish town - but in France, in the Pyrenees. This bizarre quirk is due to a treaty signed centuries ago. This really is a case for Crazy Borders! 
From 13.07.2022 10:19

item.title: Tzedek: The Righteous Ones (1/2) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.10.2024)
item.description:
When many people kept their heads down as the Jews of Europe were sent to the concentration camps, some men and women risked their lives to save Jewish people during the Second World War. Mark Halter sets out to find the people from across Europe and beyond who saved 500,000 Jews from the Holocaust.
From 21.10.2024 15:26

item.title: Mafia and Banks (3/3) - Crime without Limits (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:
Three-part documentary telling the little-known story of strong links between criminal organisations and the banking sector. Last episode: As the collapse of the USSR drew near, senior KGB officers planned to move some of the Soviet Union’s resources across the Iron Curtain, placing them in shell companies on Cyprus.
From 25.01.2024 15:30

item.title: At War for Algeria - Popular Uprising (2/6) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.10.2024)
item.description:
In the name of keeping the peace, France violently repressed the revolt in Algeria with summary executions, torture and forced displacement. This galvanised the independence struggle even more. After attacks on colonial villages in August 1955, which caused 120 deaths, the massacres of some 10,000 Algerian civilians in reprisal fanned the flames of the insurrection.
From 23.10.2024 05:00

item.title: The Battle of Chile (2/3) - The Coup d'Etat (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.09.2023)
item.description:
Between March and September 1973, the left and right clashed on all fronts: In the streets, the factories, the courts and the universities, Parliament and the media. The US government continued to interfere by financing those fermenting chaos. As the military conspired in Valparaiso, the middle classes encouraged the unrest.
From 12.09.2023 11:30

item.title: At War for Algeria - End of Empire (1/6) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.10.2024)
item.description:
1 November 1954: Brahim, a bus driver, witnesses the killing of two passengers in the mountainous region of Aurès, Algeria. The attack, by the Algerian National Liberation Front, is one of many that take place that day in the French colony. It marked the beginning of a bitter and bloody war that would spell the end of French Algeria, a colony since 1830.
From 23.10.2024 05:00

item.title: Crazy Borders - Nahwa and Madha: An Enclave within an Enclave (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2024)
item.description:
On a map, the village of Nahwa looks like a fried egg: An Emirati enclave in the Omani territory of Mahda, itself landlocked in the United Arab Emirates. The reason for this? The choice of local people decades ago at a time when water was more precious than oil.
From 25.09.2024 15:42

item.title: Joachim Roncin, the Mind Behind "Je suis Charlie" - Domino Effect (3/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Joachim Roncin is the artist behind the iconic black and white image ‘Je Suis Charlie’. He was in the middle of an editorial meeting at Stylist when alerts started to come through: a fellow magazine, Charlie Hebdo, had been wiped out in a bloody massacre. Joachim’s image captured the pain of a nation.
From 24.08.2021 20:20
